description: Reconcile the existing src/components/shared/navbar.tsx to match Figma Nav Bar section 451:1352 (main row 451:1151) while KEEPING its public API, next-intl strings, locale-switcher, theme-toggle, Logo, and mobile Sheet intact. Integrate the SearchBar molecule from FEAT-002 into the desktop row. Depends on FEAT-002 (SearchBar). Last functional feature before the convergence/verification tail.
steps: Confirm the only Navbar call site is src/app/[locale]/(public)/layout.tsx (<Navbar /> with no props) via grep; the public API must stay `export async function Navbar()` with no required props so that call site keeps compiling.

Reconcile navbar.tsx to Figma 451:1151: keep it a Server Component (async, getTranslations('nav') + getTranslations('common')). Surface bg-card (#fafafa) with the drop shadow (shadow-[0_4px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)]) while keeping sticky top-0 z-40 and backdrop; padding x24/y12 (px-6 py-3); justify-between layout. Keep Logo, LocaleSwitcher, ThemeToggle, the two auth Buttons, and the mobile Sheet exactly as wired (same imports, same routes/links shape).

Give the nav label links Default/Hover/Pressed/Disabled states matching Figma: base text-[18px] leading-7 font-medium text-muted-foreground (paragraph-md, arbitrary — tokens unchanged), hover:text-primary, active/aria-current pressed text-primary-pressed, disabled text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none with reduced opacity. Reuse existing nav.* i18n keys for labels; add a new key only if genuinely required and then to both ar.json + en.json.
Integrate the SearchBar molecule (from @/components/molecules) into the desktop nav row as Figma shows, without breaking the mobile layout or the auth buttons.
Verify the public layout still builds and renders Navbar unchanged in API.
acceptance_criteria: navbar.tsx still exports `async function Navbar()` with no required props; src/app/[locale]/(public)/layout.tsx compiles unchanged.

Navbar visually matches Figma 451:1151 (surface/shadow, x24/y12 padding, justify-between, paragraph-md label states Default/Hover/Pressed/Disabled) using logical properties only and semantic tokens (light+dark).
Logo, LocaleSwitcher, ThemeToggle, mobile Sheet, and both auth buttons remain present and functional; the SearchBar molecule is integrated into the desktop row.
All navbar strings still go through next-intl; any added key exists in both ar.json and en.json.
verification: npm run build (the (public) layout renders Navbar successfully)
